outcome: birth experience (measured by the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire)
cohort: Pregnant women with fear of birth (n=181)
finding: Randomization to receive iCBT or counseling with midwives for fear of birth was not associated with perceptions of the birth experience assessed one year after birth.
mod_finding: Preferred mode of birth and actual mode of birth were associated with some domains of the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire.
